rows.claim: code_map.md:848 gives the Spec line of the src/library.jl entry as §2.3, §5.4, §5.5, §6.2, §6.3, §8.1, §8.7, §10.4, §13.5, §13.7 and D-entries up to D-438. Code comments in this range cite §3.1, §5.3, §10.6, §13.8 and D-362, which the line omits.
rows.evidence: src/library.jl:1589 (§10.6), 2074 (§5.3), 2165 (§3.1), 2570 and 2931 (§13.8), 1648 (D-362); design/code_map.md:848. The map header says an entry's citations change with the code's.
rows.note: Other cites of §3.1 and §5.3 outside my range (src/library.jl:444, 904) support the same omission.

rows.claim: code_map.md:814-823 lists `shape_type` among the helpers 'shared with the trackers and FirstOrderLag'. `shape_type` serves only the two PIDs, and `FirstOrderLag` shares only `check_time_constant`. The tracker entry lists the helpers shared with the PID and omits `check_time_constant`, which both trackers call.
rows.evidence: src/library.jl:2551 and 2687 are the only calls of shape_type. The trackers size by tracker_sizes (2917, 3043). FirstOrderLag calls check_time_constant at 1006. LQRTracker calls it at 2910 and DiscreteLQRTracker at 3036. design/code_map.md:814-823.
rows.fix: Split the PID bullet: 'the helpers `shape_type` and `fixed_parameters`, `check_tracking`, `check_output_limits`, `check_time_constant`, the last four shared with the trackers, and `check_time_constant` with `FirstOrderLag`'. In the tracker bullet add `check_time_constant` to 'shared with the PID'.
rows.note: Low severity. The sentence is ambiguous rather than flatly false.
